I made a portrait mod for Abigail to fit a more eerie playthrough.
Ideally, I would like to do all characters, and I will be updating this mod as I draw more. 

Beach and winter outfits included.
I've reinterpreted the design a little, so it might not match the stripes.

[b][size=4]
HOW TO INSTALL THIS MOD[/size]
[/b][size=3]This mod requires Portraiture to work.
You will need to extract the folders from the zipped file into "Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits".
Once you've done that, launch the game. Talk to Abigail, and when her dialogue box shows up, press "P". You are now able to freely choose whichever portrait you like. [/size]


[b][size=4]***Important note: [/size][/b]I have not been able to figure out how to make Portraiture show the winter sprites in winter, or the beach stripes. So, the work-around I have found is to create three separate portrait folders, each for its own variant, and you will need to manually switch between them in game based on context. So, when winter comes, you will need to manually switch to "Gloomy Winter".

[b][size=2]**If you know any easier way to do this, please tell me. I'm not a programmer lmao. [/size]

[/b]
